dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: Hahh... I'm still alive...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: Honestly? Much better. I really owe you one back there. I was so cold I couldn't even walk. Without your help, I'd probably be frozen stiff like some ice sculpture by now.

dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: Oh, right. These Glaciafruit are a specialty my family just sent over. Fresh as can be! Consider them my thanks for saving my life.

dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: Hehe, a rough fellow like me doesn't have anything valuable to offer, so I hope you won't mind, my friend!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry about it. Just take care of yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: I will, I will. Thanks for caring!

dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: Strange... Since when could a little cold get the better of me like that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are you feeling now?

dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: Pretty much recovered. I feel like if I rest a little longer, I'll be ready to head back down and get to work.

dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: Still, it's really strange. I've been mining ice here for years without any trouble, so why did the cold suddenly get to me today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: Take care, friend! And thanks again for before!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could it have been because of the Glaciafruit...

dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: Hey! Now that you mention it, that really might be it! I must've been afraid of the cold because I was working on an empty stomach and got weak! Ah, if only I'd eaten them sooner...

dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: All right, it's decided! Next time I go out, I'll stuff a few more of them in my pockets to keep the cold off!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, could it be because the Glaciafruit were too cold?

dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: Oh, that's what you mean. Well, nothing to be done about that. Think about it. Down there, anything you carry with you to eat is going to end up frozen solid anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: Look at it that way, and chewing on Glaciafruit is much easier than gnawing on rye bread frozen hard as stone! They're crunchy, like eating ice cream, and they're more nutritious too!

dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: Of course, the main reason is that I just like them! Haha, you should definitely try one sometime, my friend!
